PROBABILITY FUNCTIONS (p.934)
Relation of P(x) and Z^{(m)}(x) to Other Functions
Function  Relation
26.2.29  Error function  \mathrm{erf}\ x=2P(x\sqrt2)-1 \quad (x\geq0)
26.2.30  Incomplete gamma function (special case)  \frac{\gamma(\tfrac12, x)}{\Gamma(\tfrac12)}=[2P(\sqrt{2x})-1] \quad (x\geq0)
26.2.31  Hermite polynomial  He_n(x)=(-1)^n \frac{Z^{(n)}(x)}{Z(x)}
26.2.32  Hermite polynomial  H_n(x)=(-1)^n2^{n/2} \frac{Z^{(n)}(x\sqrt2)}{Z(x\sqrt2)}
26.2.33  Hh function  Hh_{-n}(x)=(-1)^{n-1}\sqrt{2\pi}Z^{(n-1)}(x) \quad (n>0)
26.2.34  Hh function  Hh_n(x)=(-1)^nHh_{-1}(x) \frac{d^n}{dx^n}\left(\frac{Q(x)}{Z(x)}\right) \quad (n>0)
26.2.35  Tetrachoric function  \tau_n(x)=\frac{(-1)^{n-1}}{\sqrt{n!}} Z^{(n-1)}(x)
26.2.36  Confluent hypergeometric function (special case)  M\left(\frac12, \frac32, -\frac{x^2}{2}\right)=\frac{\sqrt{2\pi}}{x}\left\{P(x)-\frac12\right\} \quad (x>0)
26.2.37  Confluent hypergeometric function (special case)  M\left(1, \frac32, \frac{x^2}{2}\right)=\frac{1}{xZ(x)}\left\{P(x)-\frac12\right\} \quad (x>0)
26.2.38  Confluent hypergeometric function (special case)  M\left(\frac{2m+1}{2}, \frac12, -\frac{x^2}{2}\right)=\frac{Z^{(2m)}(x)}{Z^{(2m)}(0)} \quad (x\geq0)
26.2.39  Confluent hypergeometric function (special case)  M\left(\frac{2m+2}{2}, \frac32, -\frac{x^2}{2}\right)=\frac{Z^{(2m-1)}(x)}{xZ^{(2m)}(0)} \quad (x\geq0)
26.2.40  Parabolic cylinder function  U\left(-n-\frac12, x\right)=e^{-\tfrac14x^2}(-1)^n \frac{Z^{(n)}(x)}{Z(x)} \quad (n>0)
Repeated Integrals of the Normal Probability Integral
26.2.41  I_n(x)=\int_x^\infty I_{n-1}(t)dt \quad (n\geq0)
where I_{-1}(x)=Z(x)
26.2.42  I_{-n}(x)=\left(-\frac{d}{dx}\right)^{n-1}Z(x)=(-1)^{n-1}Z^{(n-1)}(x) \quad (n\geq-1)
26.2.43  \left(\frac{d^2}{dx^2}+x\frac{d}{dn}-n\right)I_n(x)=0
26.2.44  (n+1)I_{n+1}(x)+xI_n(x)-I_{n-1}(x)=0 \quad (n>-1)
note: Two-column relation table (Function | Relation), 26.2.29-26.2.44 (relates P(x)/Z(x) to erf, incomplete gamma, Hermite/Hh/tetrachoric/parabolic-cylinder functions, then repeated integrals). Ditto marks kept as the word they stand for, matching the prior row's Function name.
